matching: A model can fill a reading field from the subject's profile instead of the note. After every read, keep a colour or a direction other than unknown only when one of its words below is a whole word of the note, case-insensitive; the single letters N, E, S and W count only when written in capitals. Keep footwear or carried only when it shares a word with the note: words are runs of letters, lowercased, at least minSharedWordLength letters long and not in stopWords. Otherwise blank the field: unknown for a colour or a direction, empty text for footwear or carried. A note is split into words on anything that is not a letter, and a hyphenated or spaced pair (north-east, north east) also counts as the joined word.
